# ReMeet — Full Reference

> ReMeet is a done-for-you photo book design service. You share an iCloud or Google Photos link, a designer curates your best photos, lays out every page, and delivers a proof within 72 hours. Every book is checked by a person, not auto-generated. Digital book from $29 (30 pages) or $79 (100 pages). Add video frame extraction for +$50. Printed hardcover from $25. Founded by Olga Miller, based in Porto, Portugal, serving customers worldwide.

## Pricing

- Digital photo book, up to 30 pages: $29
- Digital photo book, up to 100 pages: $79
- Video frame extraction add-on: +$50
- Printed classic hardcover (30 pages): $25
- Printed classic hardcover (100 pages): $49
- Premium layflat (30 pages): $89
- Premium layflat (100 pages): $149
- US shipping (classic): $7.60
- Canada / Europe shipping: quoted individually

## How it works

1. Pick your book type and page count on remeet.cc
2. Pay securely via Stripe
3. Share a link to your photos (iCloud link, Google Photos album, or any cloud folder)
4. A designer curates your best shots, removes duplicates, and designs every page
5. Receive a designed PDF proof within 72 hours
6. Request changes in plain language (two revision rounds included)
7. Approve and download your digital book
8. Optionally order a printed hardcover copy

## What makes ReMeet different

- A designer checks every book by hand — not auto-generated templates
- AI sorts and selects photos, but never changes or generates them
- 5 minutes of your time vs. 4-8 hours of DIY layout work
- Accepts up to 5,000 photos per book
- Works with any photo source: iPhone, Android, DSLR
- Square hardcover, 21x21 cm, 200gsm gloss archival pages
